note: Primitive 8-site FCFS campground along Tumbling Creek near Ocoee #3 Lake, Cherokee NF (Ocoee/Big Frog Mountain region). No reservations (not on recreation.gov). Mostly small RVs/vans/cars, but the first couple of sites fit medium RVs/trailers with room to turn around (23-ft feasible). No designated pads, no hookups, no toilets/water/tables; max 5 people & 2 vehicles per site; bear-proof food storage required. Access via gravel FR 45/FR 221; easiest approach is paved Grassy Creek Rd off Hwy 68 then ~2 mi on FR 221 — passable by a normal vehicle. Open year-round. FCFS — not on recreation.gov. --Claude
